description: This file defines the BatchTbRuleEngineSubmitStrategy class, which manages batching and submission of messages to a rule engine within the Thingsboard platform. It handles batching logic, message processing, and success callbacks.

classes.name: BatchTbRuleEngineSubmitStrategy
classes.description: Manages batching and submission of messages to the rule engine, extending AbstractTbRuleEngineSubmitStrategy.

methods.name: BatchTbRuleEngineSubmitStrategy
methods.description: Constructor initializing the strategy with queue name and batch size.

methods.name: submitAttempt
methods.description: Sets the message consumer and initiates message submission.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the reprocessing map and resets batch index.

methods.name: doOnSuccess
methods.description: Handles successful message processing, removing the message from pending pack and triggering next batch if needed.

methods.name: submitNext
methods.description: Prepares and submits the next batch of messages based on current batch index.
